items.escena: A clay piggy bank cracked open and empty, with a long unpaid bill scroll unrolling beside it
A peaceful march of young clay students carrying blank banners in a plaza with old buildings, a white dove flying above

A clay revolutionary with a wide sombrero and crossed ammunition belts beside an old telegraph machine
A modern clay factory with shipping containers and a trailer truck, a face mask hanging on a hook

A clay candle lantern, a quill pen and an old steam train model on a wooden table
A clay radio, an old television with antennas and a rotary telephone on a table
A clay smartphone, a laptop and a small satellite model on a table
